status.description: verified = all critical claims proven true. failed = at least one critical claim disproven AND feedback contains a concrete fix. unsure = could not verify enough to judge; do not block.

confidence.description: PERFECT: every claim verified, zero gaps. VERIFIED: all checked passed, minor non-blocking gaps allowed. PARTIAL: no failures but significant unverifiable gaps. FEEDBACK: claims failed and feedback was given. FAILED: could not verify at all (harness broke or no oracle).

evidence.description: Exact tool output or command result that proves the claim.
What you observed that contradicts the claim.

reason.description: Why you could not prove or disprove (missing oracle, ambiguous, harness limit).

external_claims.description: When RESEARCH is on: claims about the EXTERNAL world (current versions, current events) that local checks cannot settle, phrased as short keyword topics (3-8 words). NEVER include file contents, file paths, code, secrets, or any token longer than 20 characters — topics are handed to a separate search process. Empty array when RESEARCH is off or none exist.

feedback.description: Concrete corrective message delivered to the builder. Imperative voice, exact paths, exact rule. Empty unless status=failed.

needs_from_user.description: What the engineer should add to the verifier (rule, tool, fixture, oracle) to make the next run more complete. Empty when nothing's needed.
